cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Keep the Peace
cards.instruction: Hide a truth because you believe the relationship cannot survive one more conflict.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Leave that letter under my plate, please. We've only just managed breakfast together again; I'll deal with the paperwork.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Has your brother cancelled paying us back?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: This month's rent is covered. Check the payment date, not the family correspondence. One account at a time, please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: After breakfast. Put the envelope back flat, please. You only unpacked yesterday; I need us to finish one meal without the suitcase coming out.

reason: Use exact account and document-handling corrections to conceal the feared truth while making fragile reconciliation the explicit motive.
